games.title: Don't Sell the Cat
games.summary: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.
games.details: First-person horror · about 2 hours · 10 endings · English and Korean · Windows version included
games.requires: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 12 or later · 369 MB

games.title: Stakeholders
games.summary: You owe ₩96,000,000. A day labor office down an alley that isn't on any map pays ₩300,000 a night, cash the same night, for jobs for the dead: carry a memorial meal across the alley before it goes cold, empty Room 204 while its owner dances, keep watch at a funeral that has no chief mourner, work the night shift at a convenience store where the second clerk isn't a person. The manager knows your name. You never told him.
games.details: First-person horror · Korean and English · single player · the demo ends after the first night at the convenience store
games.requires: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 12 or later · demo 479 MB
